Assert glyph criteria: U+2260 count >= 2, bare U+0338 count == 0

deviations.description: Assert the glyph criteria on the scratch output: != count >= 2, bare U+0338 count == 0
deviations.reason: The plan's literal `grep -c '≠'` command returned exit 1 (no matches) despite a UTF-8 locale (en_US.UTF-8), an apparent character-encoding mismatch on the literal glyph as passed through this environment's command string -- not a content defect. Direct Python codepoint counting on the same file confirms U+2260 count = 2, bare U+0338 count = 0, at exactly the two expected sentence positions.
